```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
run_rlm = function(data,
                   metabolites,
                   outcomes = c("cqi_est"), # Uno o varios
                   method = "lm", # Uno o varios (uno por outcome)
                   covariates = "", # + var1 + var2...
                   digits_coef = 2,
                   digits_p = 3,
                   p_adjust_method = "BH",
                   export_path = NULL,
                   tolower_names = T) {
  
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ARGUMENTOS:
  # data: Base de datos con outcome, covariables y metabolitos (ej. Met_CQI_rl2)
  # metabolites: Vector con los nombres de los metabolitos a iterar
  # outcome: Nombre de la variable respuesta (default = "cqi_est")
  # method: "lm" para modelos lineales, "rlm" para modelos robustos
  # covariates: Cadena con las covariables del modelo (incluye los "+" necesarios)
  # digits_coef: Decimales para redondear Coef e IC (default = 2)
  # digits_p: Decimales para redondear p-value (default = 3)
  # p_adjust_method: Método de p.adjust (default = "BH")
  # export_path: (Opcional) Ruta completa del archivo .xlsx a exportar. Si es NULL, no exporta
  # tolower_names: (Logical) Si TRUE, aplica tolower() a metabolites (default = TRUE)
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  
  if (!requireNamespace("dplyr", quietly = T)) stop("Necesitas 'dplyr'")
  if (length(method) == 1) {
    method_vec = rep(method, length(outcomes))
  } else if (length(method) == length(outcomes)) {
    method_vec = method
  } else {
    stop("La longitud de 'method' debe ser 1 o coincidir con la longitud de 'outcomes'")
  }
  if ("rlm" %in% method_vec && !requireNamespace("MASS", quietly = T)) {
    stop("Necesitas 'MASS' instalado porque has seleccionado 'rlm' en algún outcome")
  }

  mets = metabolites
  if (tolower_names) mets = tolower(mets)
  
  fmt_p = function(p) {
    if (is.na(p)) return(NA_real_)
    round(p, digits_p)
  }
  
  total_iter = length(mets) * length(outcomes)
  fits = vector("list", total_iter)
  rows = vector("list", total_iter)
  k = 1 

  for (j in seq_along(outcomes)) {
    
    curr_outcome = outcomes[j]
    curr_method  = method_vec[j]
    
    if (!curr_method %in% c("lm", "rlm")) {
      warning(paste("Método desconocido:", curr_method, "--> Usando 'lm' por defecto"))
      curr_method = "lm"
    }

    if (!curr_outcome %in% names(data)) {
      warning(paste("El outcome", curr_outcome, "no existe en data. Saltando..."))
      k = k + length(mets)
      next
    }

    for (i in seq_along(mets)) {
      var = mets[i]
      
      empty_row = data.frame(Outcome = curr_outcome, Variable = var, Method = curr_method, 
                             Coef = NA, IC_low = NA, IC_high = NA, p_value = NA, 
                             stringsAsFactors = F)
      
      if (!var %in% names(data)) {
        rows[[k]] = empty_row
        k = k + 1
        next
      }
      
      f = as.formula(paste0(var, " ~ ", curr_outcome, " ", covariates))
      
      if (curr_method == "rlm") {
        modelo = tryCatch(MASS::rlm(f, data = data), error = function(e) NULL)
      } else {
        modelo = tryCatch(lm(f, data = data), error = function(e) NULL)
      }
      
      if (is.null(modelo)) {
        rows[[k]] = empty_row
        k = k + 1
        next
      }
      
      fits[[k]] = modelo
      resumen = summary(modelo)
      rn = rownames(resumen$coefficients)
      idx = match(curr_outcome, rn)
      
      if (curr_method == "rlm") {
        conf_int = tryCatch(suppressMessages(confint.default(modelo)), 
                            error = function(e) NULL)
        if (!is.na(idx) && !is.null(conf_int)) {
          t_val = resumen$coefficients[idx, 3]
          p_val_final = 2*(1-pnorm(abs(t_val)))
        } else { p_val_final = NA }
      } else {
        conf_int = tryCatch(suppressMessages(confint(modelo)), 
                            error = function(e) NULL)
        if (!is.na(idx) && !is.null(conf_int)) {
          p_val_final = resumen$coefficients[idx, 4]
        } else { p_val_final = NA }
      }
      
      if (is.na(idx) || is.null(conf_int)) {
        rows[[k]] = empty_row
      } else {
        rows[[k]] = data.frame(Outcome = curr_outcome,
                               Variable = var,
                               Method = curr_method,
                               Coef = round(resumen$coefficients[idx, 1], digits_coef),
                               IC_low = round(conf_int[idx, 1], digits_coef),
                               IC_high = round(conf_int[idx, 2], digits_coef),
                               p_value = fmt_p(p_val_final),
                               stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      }
      k = k + 1
    }
  }
  
  resultados = dplyr::bind_rows(rows) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(Variable))
  
  if (nrow(resultados) > 0) {
    resultados = resultados %>%
      dplyr::group_by(Outcome) %>% 
      dplyr::mutate(
        padj = round(p.adjust(p_value, method = p_adjust_method), 3),
        res = dplyr::case_when(padj < 0.001 ~ "***",
                               padj < 0.01  ~ "**",
                               padj < 0.05  ~ "*",
                               TRUE ~ NA_character_)
      ) %>%
      dplyr::ungroup()
  }
  if (!is.null(export_path)) {
    if (!requireNamespace("rio", quietly = T)) stop("Instala 'rio'")
    rio::export(resultados, export_path)
  }
  invisible(list(fits = fits, results = resultados))
}
```
